definitions.gloss: compilation episode; best-of edition; recap episode
definitions.explanation: A special episode or edition that compiles highlights, key scenes, or the best content from a series, show, or publication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総集編|そうしゅうへん}です。
examples.english: Next week is a recap episode.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総集編|そうしゅうへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A compilation episode of the first half was broadcast.

examples.japanese: ⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総集編|そうしゅうへん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: A compilation movie of the anime series is going to be released in theaters.

notes:
A compound of {総集|そうしゅう} (compiling together) and ⟦{編|へん}→〜編：28472_hen⟧ (volume, edition). Very common in the context of TV dramas, anime, and variety shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総集編|そうしゅうへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}する→放送する：01852_housousuru⟧: to broadcast a recap episode
- {総集編|そうしゅうへん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: compilation movie
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧{総集編|そうしゅうへん}: year-end compilation
- ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総集編|そうしゅうへん}: first-half recap

USAGE:
In anime and TV dramas, a {総集編|そうしゅうへん} is sometimes aired between story arcs to give the production team extra time, or at the end of a season to recap the story. While some fans see them as filler, {総集編|そうしゅうへん} movies that rework TV anime for the big screen have become a popular format in the anime industry.
